description.value: Afternoon matinee show: the plan centers on TKTS by TDF, the nonprofit booth that sells discounted same-day and next-day theater seats. You can line up at the Times Square booth or the quieter Lincoln Center location. Pick a matinee, see a Broadway show by early evening, and still have the night free for dinner.
